title: Haʻikū stream water testing funding
summary: On April 21, a motion carried to add up to $40,000 to environmental protection grants for the Haʻikū Community Association stream testing program. The money was sought by a Haʻikū community group that asked on April 16 to restore $40,000 for a fourth year of stream testing, and a Haʻikū Community Association testifier backed it. Residents had spoken about testing of surface water and streams at a Haʻikū-area meeting on April 6.
